systems.country_label: système d'information foncier e-Foncier Bénin (cadastre national)
systems.owner: Agence Nationale du Domaine et du Foncier (ANDF)
systems.tiers: National agency's land information system; parcels recorded for 24 arrondissements in 12 communes in three years (460,000 parcels), as stated on 10 February 2023. No commune office is said to work in it.

note: The national cadastre is a national agency's system covering parcels in 12 communes; the document says nothing of commune offices being connected or working in it.
